group.label: Image File Cleanup
group.comment: Run bin/magento mageos:catalog-images:cleanup --dry-run to list the product and category image files that are no longer used, then without --dry-run to delete them.

field.label: Delete Files When Images Are Removed
field.comment: When a category image is removed or replaced, or a product or category is deleted, the image files (and the resized product images) are deleted as soon as no product, category or content uses them anymore.

field.label: Keep Files Linked in Content
field.comment: Also look for the image path in CMS pages and blocks, product and category descriptions, widgets and configuration values before deleting a file. Safer, slightly slower on very large catalogs.
